item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 07/Oct/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. A cooler replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China between Sunday night and Monday morning. The weather will be generally fine and dry over the region next week. It will be cooler in the morning and at night. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.

Date/Month: 08/10 (Saturday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore.
Weather: Sunny periods. A few showers at first.
Temp range: 25 - 31 C
R.H. range: 60 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low
